title: Large bundle build at the memory ceiling
intent: Boundary fixture: memory pressure is the incumbent's own open issue, so this fixture is informative rather than pass/fail. It exists to find the ceiling deliberately instead of discovering it in production.
source: our own scenario, informed by the incumbent's open memory issue
knownLimits: A TIMEOUT is a legitimate result and must be recorded, never retried until it passes. Charter §4.5 fixes the budget at 240s for builds.

This is a deliberate probe, not a pass/fail gate: 300 generated modules of ~40 kB each is ~12 MB of source, enough to walk the graph for real but not a tuned attempt to find the exact ceiling. The runtime has no memory instrumentation yet, so what this records is whether that build completes inside the budget, not how close to a limit it ran.
